mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/version-scheme.md <<'EOF'
# Version Numbering Scheme

The project's current recorded decision is to use semantic versioning (semver), in the major.minor.patch form: a major-version bump signals breaking changes, a minor bump signals new backward-compatible features, and a patch bump signals backward-compatible bug fixes. The rationale recorded for this choice is that semver gives users explicit compatibility signals, which helps them decide when and how to update their dependencies.
EOF
cat docs/policies/version-scheme.md
